title: Multimodal deep learning triages new keratoconus referrals by progression risk
summary: AUROC was 0.84 from a single visit and 0.93 with sequential visits in an external validation cohort of 963 eyes (519 patients); 58% were classified low risk. The study is retrospective and the triage is simulated.
ai_technology: Multimodal and LSTM deep learning models predicting keratoconus progression
organization: Moorfields Eye Hospital NHS Trust, London, UK; University College London, UK

evidence.unknown: Retrospective; simulated triage; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Multimodal and LSTM deep learning predicts keratoconus progression
